How to read these deals

All included prices were observed on retailer pages. The percentage and dollar savings compare the selling price to the displayed retailer reference price or the explicitly identified manufacturer list price. These comparisons do not establish the usual selling price, lowest historical price, or future availability. A 39.97% discount does not pass the 40% filter; filters use the unrounded calculation. Target was checked for ZIP 85308 and Walmart for the browser’s displayed ZIP 95829. Check your address and final total before buying. This file never refreshes its prices automatically.
